newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Eicher Ltd 1st half 96/97 net rises.
newsitem.headline: India's Eicher Ltd 1st half 96/97 net rises.

text.p: Indian tractor and vehicle maker Eicher Ltd said on Friday that it posted net profit of 146 million rupees in the first half of 1996/97 (April-March) compared to 125 million in the same period last year.
It said in a statement that sales of 2.47 billion rupees were 23 percent higher than in the first half of 1995/96.

"All the business units of Eicher Limited, namely Eicher Tractors, Royal Enfield and Ramon and Demm showed a strong growth in the first half, continuing the trend established in the last few years," it added.
The statement quoted Eicher group chief executive Subodh Bhargava as saying Eicher Tractors planned to sell 5,500 units of 35 horse-power tractors in 1996/97.
Eicher Ltd is part of the Eicher group, which is involved in the manufacture and marketing of light commercial vehicles, and exports of vehicles and components.
